parameters.prompt: Stop-motion claymation diorama, a handmade clay relief backdrop, wide panoramic 2:1 composition. A sandy orange desert at dusk under two glowing suns low on the horizon, one big and golden, one smaller and coral pink. Rolling dunes in chunky sculpted modeling clay with visible thumbprints and tool marks. On the left, a small rusty dome-shaped clay hut with a round wooden door. On the right, a battered, patched, boxy space truck with dents, rivets, a round cockpit window and stubby tail fins, resting on short landing legs. High in the lavender and dusty pink sky, a big pale grey moon with a tiny door and two little square windows, looking suspicious. Matte modeling clay, chunky rounded shapes, saturated slightly chalky colors (sand orange, dusty pink, lavender, teal shadows), soft warm stage lighting, shallow layered relief like a painted theater backdrop, the middle kept open and uncluttered. No characters, no people, no robots, no animals, no text, no letters, no logos. Composition for a theater backdrop seen behind actors: the most interesting scenery sits in the upper left, the upper right and the middle band; the top center is calm and simple; the bottom third is a plain, simple, uncluttered floor or ground with no objects. Warm, glowing color palette like a cozy old opera house stage.
parameters.negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, signature, people, characters, person, robot, animals, creatures, hands, photorealistic, glossy plastic, frame, border, blurry
